name: viberaven
description: Production context and checks for AI-built apps across their providers. Local race tests two users at once on real PostgreSQL and replays exactly what broke.

interface.shortDescription: Production context, checks and two-user PostgreSQL race tests.
interface.longDescription: VibeRaven gives AI-built apps production context and checks across Supabase, Vercel, Stripe and the other providers they use, read from the repo, locally, before launch and after a change. Run npx -y viberaven@1.10.0 race --example, then check, race, fix and replay in your repo. Open the Studio for provider context, releases and diffs.
defaultPrompt: Use architecture-context at the start of real app work to ask low-level product questions, then route answered work to architecture-plan before a fix.
Use the VibeRaven flow: architecture questions -> architecture plan -> version/release context -> provider boundary -> MCP/Studio context -> scoped fix.
Ask concise missing-context questions before planning when architecture, last working version, provider, or deploy target is unclear.
Use what-broke to find what changed and which architecture boundary is affected before editing.
Use go-live when the user wants GitHub push, Vercel deploy, and live URL proof.
